y-m-10-01.s.s1.explain: Tirooyinka dabiiciga ah ee lambarkoodii koowaad aanu ahayn 0, midka leh lambarro badan ayaa weyn. 987,654 waa tiro lix-lambar ah 1,000,000 na waa tiro toddobo-lambar ah. y-m-10-06.title: Ma noo sheegi karaan diiwaannada saddexda bilood bisha soo socota?
y-m-10-06.topic: Tirinta boodboodka ee tirooyinka waaweyn iyo xadka saadaalinta xeer ku salaysan
y-m-10-06.goal: Saadaali tirada xigta oo ka timaadda diiwaan ku boodboodaya 100,000, laakiin tusaale lid ku ah ku muuji in dhawr diiwaan aanay ka dhigi karin 'hubaal', kuna kala sooc saadaalinta iyo hubaasha.
y-m-10-06.material: Beer madadaalo ayaa diiwaan geliyay tirada booqdayaasha bil kasta. Diiwaannadu waxay ku qoran yihiin keliya cutubyada 10,000 qof, sidaa darteed had iyo jeer waa isku-dhufashooyin 10,000. Janaayo waa 3,420,000 qof, Febraayo waa 3,520,000 qof, Maarso waa 3,620,000 qof. Mina waxay tidhi, “Bishiiba waxay kor u socotaa 100,000 qof, markaa Abriil waxay hubaal noqonaysaa 3,720,000 qof!”
y-m-10-06.thinking.0: Qiimeynta heerka hubaasha ee saadaalin ku salaysan xeer
y-m-10-06.thinking.1: Samaynta tusaale lid ku ah oo jebiya 'hubaal'
y-m-10-06.thinking.2: Qorista saadaalin iyo sheegasho adag oo ah laba shay oo kala duwan
y-m-10-06.prereq.0: Akhrinta iyo qorista tirooyin waaweyn oo cutubyo boqol-kun iyo milyan ah (heerka fasalka 4aad)
y-m-10-06.s.s1.prompt: Waa kee fikirka ugu habboon ee ku saabsan waxa Mina tidhi?
y-m-10-06.s.s1.hint.0: Hel intay le'eg tahay tirada qof ee kor u kacday Janaayo ilaa Febraayo iyo Febraayo ilaa Maarso.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir hal xaalad oo Abriil ay qiimo kale yeelan karto (tusaale, cimilada ama dhacdo), kuna fikir in diiwaannadu keligood sidaas sheegi karaan.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.a: Qiyaastii 3,720,000 qof waa saadaalin dabiici ah, laakiin qiimo kale ayaa soo bixi kara
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad xeerka ka akhriday diiwaannada, waxaadna kaloo kala soocday saadaalinta iyo hubaasha.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.b: 3,720,000 qof waa hubaal sax. Maxaa yeelay saddexda bilood oo dhan waxay kordheen 100,000
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.b: Xaqiiqda ah in saddex jeer ay isku mid ahayd ayaad ka gaartay gabagabo ah in weligeed sidaas ahaan doonto. Ka fikir in ay jirto caddayn ah in markii afraad sidoo kale ay isku mid noqon doonto.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.c: Abriil gabi ahaanba lama oga. Saddexda diiwaan ee hore waxtar uma laha saadaalinta
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad iska tuurtay dhammaan diiwaannadii hore. Ka fikir in ay yihiin tilmaan xeerka.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.o.d: Waxay u muuqataa qiyaastii 3,620,000 qof, laakiin way khaldami kartaa
y-m-10-06.s.s1.r.d: Si taxadar leh ayaad u hadashay, laakiin ma isticmaalin xadiga korodhka oo laga akhriyi karo diiwaannada.
y-m-10-06.s.s1.explain: In ay kor u kacday 100,000 saddexda bilood waa tilmaan muujinaya inay u badan tahay inay kor u kacdo cadad le'eg Abriil sidoo kale. Laakiin xadiga korodhka Abriil way ka duwanaan kartaa, markaa ma odhan kartid 'hubaal'. Iska tuurista dhammaan diiwaannada (c) ama iska indho-tirka xadiga korodhka (d) sidoo kale ma aha saadaalin wanaagsan.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.prompt: Samee diiwaanno muujinaya in 'hubaal' ee Mina ay khaldami karto. Janaayo, Febraayo, iyo Maarso tirada waxay kordhaysaa 100,000 mid kasta, Abriilna ma aha 100,000 ka badan Maarso. Dhammaan diiwaannadu waa tirooyin toddoba lambar ah, Janaayo iyo Abriilna waa isku-dhufashooyin 10,000. Samee laba diiwaan oo isbeddelka Abriil ay kala duwan yihiin.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.hint.0: Sii deji saddexda bilood ee hore sida tusaalaha, kuna fikir qiime Abriil ah oo aan ahayn 100,000 ka badan Maarso.
y-m-10-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kadib marka aad doorato qiimaha Abriil, hubi in farqiga Maarso uusan ahayn 100,000 iyo inuu yahay isku-dhufasho 10,000.

y-m-10-06.s.s2.explain: Tusaale, 3,420,000 → 3,520,000 → 3,620,000 → 3,730,000 saddexda bilood ee hore waxay kordheen 100,000, kadibna Abriil waxay kordhay 110,000. Diiwaan hoos u dhaca, sida 5,100,000 → 5,200,000 → 5,300,000 → 5,250,000, sidoo kale waa tusaale lid ku ah. Haddii xitaa hal diiwaan oo noocaas ah suurtagal yahay, diiwaannada saddexda bilood keligood Abriil uma beddeli karaan 'hubaal' wax.
y-m-10-06.s.s3.prompt: Sidee ayaad u saadaalin lahayd tirada qof ee Abriil? Qor tirada aad saadaalisay iyo sababta, kuna qor waxa aad dheeraad u rabto inaad ogaato si ay u caawiso haddii saadaalintaadu khaldami karto.
